description: Shared Phase 1 animation state machine for cinematic chess warriors.

IdleBreathing.description: Breathing, blinking, armor micro-shift, subtle cape/hair settle.

CapeMovement.description: Cloth response to glide, turn and strike.

MoveGlide.description: Signature chess glide; full-body weight remains believable.

Defeated.description: Defeat/fall state with armor and cloth settling.

King.notes: Royal staff leads movement; sword remains readable at hip; crown/cape preserve silhouette.

Queen.notes: Crook staff remains primary silhouette; long hair and cape preserve feminine read.

Bishop.notes: Crook staff sweep on capture; tall mitre stays stable.

Knight.notes: Four horse legs, hooves and tail animate as a true centaur; sword and tower shield remain attached.

Rook.notes: Massive castle staff plants on move end; tower shield and tower pauldrons keep siege silhouette.

Pawn.notes: Spear-led infantry motion; kettle helm brim remains clear in silhouette.
